description: Source code for configuration loader in Playwright, including functions for loading, validating, and resolving configuration files, as well as defining configuration objects.

classes.name: FullConfigInternal
classes.description: Internal representation of the full Playwright configuration, including project and global settings.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Creates a configuration object, merging multiple configs and marking that defineConfig was used.

methods.name: deserializeConfig
methods.description: Deserializes a serialized configuration into a full internal config object.

methods.name: loadUserConfig
methods.description: Loads user configuration from a specified location, handling default exports.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and validates the Playwright configuration, setting up loaders and transform configs.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the structure and types of the configuration object.

methods.name: resolveConfigLocation
methods.description: Resolves the configuration file location based on input path or directory.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Finds the configuration file within a directory or returns a specific file.

methods.name: loadConfigFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration from a specified file with optional overrides.

methods.name: loadEmptyConfigForMergeReports
methods.description: Loads an empty configuration for report merging purposes.
